subject: Implementation MAP & Evaluation Plan — AnthemCare phased rollout and training cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@anthemcare.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@anthemcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation MAP & Evaluation Plan — AnthemCare phased rollout and training cadence

Hi Ellie / Tom —

Congrats on signing — attaching the mutual action plan (MAP) and an initial evaluation plan so we can align on acceptance criteria and the canary window. High-level proposal below; document + prompt set attached.

Summary (requested signoffs / confirmations in bold):
- Canary (pilot): 2-week window, targeted start: week of 2028-06-12 — small cohort (approx 10% traffic or 20k tokens/day) so we can validate latency, quality & cost.  **Please confirm a preferred canary start date.**
- Staged migration: gradual ramp across two regions (us-west then us-east) over 4 weeks with gated rollouts at 25/50/100% traffic.
- Training: two live enablement sessions + recorded playbacks for support & power users (proposed dates below). Please confirm attendee list.
- Acceptance criteria / eval plan: P95 latency < 350ms, top-level quality pass rate >= 90% on our curated prompt set, no high-severity production errors for 72h post-canary ramp.
- Rollback policy: automated fallback to model-variant + immediate throttling; detailed runbook in the MAP.

Attachments: AnthemCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, and artifacts), anthempromptset_v1.json (eval prompts + expected responses).

Next steps:
1) You confirm canary start date and training attendee list.
2) We schedule kick-off call (30 min) to walk the MAP and monitoring hooks.
3) Procurement confirms invoice start date so we can coordinate billing with cutover.

If that all looks good I’ll loop in Engineering for final capacity sizing and Monitoring for dashboard access.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@anthemcare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@anthemcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 10:05:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation MAP & Evaluation Plan — AnthemCare phased rollout and training cadence

Thanks Jordan — this looks sensible. A couple quick asks before we lock dates:

- Canary start: our team prefers week of 2028-06-12; can we target Tue 2028-06-13 start so the SRE on-call can monitor the first full business day?
- Eval granularity: can you call out the exact prompt buckets you’ll run against (sensitivity, hallucination checks, edge-case prompts)? We’ll need that for internal sign-off.
- Compliance: procurement/legal will need SOC 2 evidence and data retention settings. I’ll loop them in after we confirm scope.

Cc-ing Tom (ops) — Tom, are you good with the proposed Tue 6/13 start?

—Ellie
Director, Product Ops
AnthemCare

Ellie / Tom — great, Tue 2028-06-13 works for us. Quick answers on the two asks:

1) Prompt buckets we’ll evaluate (included in anthempromptset_v1.json):
   - Clinical triage (40 prompts): correctness + safety checks; expected pass >= 92%
   - Billing / benefits QA (25 prompts): factual accuracy + data leak checks; expected pass >= 95%
   - Edge-case escalation prompts (15 prompts): graceful degradation + fallback detection

2) Monitoring & metrics (what we’ll validate during the canary):
   - Performance: P50/P95 latency, cold-starts, tokens/sec throughput. Target P95 < 350ms.
   - Quality: prompt-level pass rate on the curated prompt set; manual review sample (50/day) during canary.
   - Reliability: error-rate < 0.5% and no SEV1 incidents for 72 hours post ramp.

3) Compliance: SOC 2 evidence & retention settings — Marissa will attach the standard SOC2 kit and a short note on data retention defaults.

I’ve uploaded the evaluation harness and prompt set to the onboarding folder (link in MAP). We’ll execute nightly runs during the canary and share an interim report every morning of the pilot.

Attachments: anthempromptset_v1.json (prompt buckets + expected outputs).

Looping in operational details from CS. A few items we own during the canary + immediate post-canary ramp:

- Monitoring: we’ll provide a Grafana dashboard and a Slack alert channel. SLOs and dashboard links are in the MAP under "Observability."
- Training: proposed sessions — Thu 2028-06-15 (Teams 60m, admin & support) and Mon 2028-06-19 (30m, power-user walkthrough); recordings + quick reference guides will be shared same day.
- Canary cadence: daily syncs for first week at 09:00 PT, then every-other-day during week two unless we see anomalies.
- On-call & escalation: Redwood will provide an on-call rotation (03:00–11:00 PT coverage) for the first 7 days post-cutover, then handoff plan detailed in MAP.

Attachments: canary-schedule.ics (training & daily stand invites).

We’ve also included a short risk table in the MAP with mitigation owners. I can run a 15-min walkthrough of the monitoring dashboard Monday if helpful.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
